title: Nourishing Japanese Chicken Katsudon
description: A kid-friendly Japanese dish featuring chicken stock concentrate and sashimi-cut chicken, served in a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Prepare the chicken breast by cutting it into thin strips and seasoning with salt and pepper.
Dip each chicken strip into the panko breadcrumbs, coating evenly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the breaded chicken until golden brown and cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chicken stock concentrate, dashi broth, soy sauce, sake, and mirin to make the sauce.
In the same skillet, add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sauce to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
To assemble the katsudon, place a few pieces of the fried chicken on top of a bed of rice in a tagliere vessel.
Spoon some of the onion and sauce mixture over the chicken.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve immediately.
